youtube.title: Why Did McDonald's Fries Change in 1990? 🍟 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Until July 1990, McDonald's cooked its fries in a blend that was about 93% beef tallow. After businessman and heart-attack survivor Phil Sokolof ran full-page newspaper ads attacking saturated fat, the chain switched to vegetable oil. To keep the old taste, US fries get 'natural beef flavor' (listed with wheat and milk derivatives), so McDonald's does not call them vegetarian in the US; a lawsuit over this was settled in 2002 for $10 million.
